# Shopify SMS Apps

Shopify email and SMS app reviews, comparisons, store-type guides and lifecycle operating plans.
Start at https://www.shopifysmsapps.com/ for navigation.
Use /use-cases for workflow eligibility and ownership, /for for store context, and /apps or /compare for supplier evaluation.
Proposed exercises are not observed merchant results. Verify current product claims using the official sources linked in each article.
